reset_help.description: {name} ({address}) is already part of a Bluetooth Mesh network. Before continuing, completely close the Steinel app and any other Bluetooth app connected to the light. Switch the light's mains power off briefly, switch it back on, and then submit this form immediately. The integration will use the short startup window to reset and provision the light automatically. If setup does not succeed, repeat these steps and reload the integration entry.
